subject: Follow-up: 30-minute product brief + tech deep-dive — choose 2-3 windows
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Thompson <ava@launchpad.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: 30-minute product brief + tech deep-dive — choose 2-3 windows

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for taking the call earlier today — I appreciated the clear breakdown of Launchpad's prioritization (model monitoring, inference cost controls, and data residency). Quick recap and proposed next step:

- Recap: you want a short product intro for stakeholders + a technical deep-dive for infra/ML engineers to validate latency/cost tradeoffs and deployment options.
- Goal for next call: 30-minute product brief (first 15) + technical deep-dive (remaining 15) focused on routing, batching, and VPC options.

Can you pick 2–3 windows that work for your team this week or next? If easier, I can send a Doodle/calendar link — happy to align on timezone (PDT/EDT) — my initial constraints below for reference. Also please confirm the technical attendee(s) you want from Launchpad (infra lead + ML/engineering owner recommended).

My suggested availability (PDT):
- Thu Sep 2 — 09:00–09:30 or 15:00–15:30
- Fri Sep 3 — 11:30–12:00
- Mon Sep 6 — 14:00–14:30

Proposed 30-min agenda:
1) 15m: product overview + quick demo (serving, routing, cost controls)
2) 15m: tech deep-dive (latency profile, batching, KV cache, VPC options)
3) 5m: next steps / mutual action plan (pilot scope, success criteria)

Attachments: post-call-notes.pdf (one-pager), brief-agenda-30min.md (tiny agenda).

Next steps: pick 2–3 windows and list any stakeholders who should join. I can loop in our solutions engineer (Karthik) and CS lead (Vanessa) once we lock.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0123

[Attachment: brief-agenda-30min.md]
